subject: Re: SSO/SAML + SCIM scope for federal procurement — artifact handoff
messages:
From: Ellen R. Hayes <ellen.hayes@statehealth.gov>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@statehealth.gov
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: SSO/SCIM artifacts for SOW — initial request

Hi Diego,

Per our procurement packet I need to collect the technical artifacts your team will provide for the SOW. Specifically the security reviewers need:

- SAML metadata and entity descriptor for any IdP/SP integration
- SCIM provisioning design and a sample delta sync report showing calendar-day deltas
- Role mapping spreadsheet (RBAC) that maps Redwood roles to least-privilege scopes
- Technical notes on account lifecycle: deprovisioning, orphaned sessions, and log retention

We would like an initial package by COB Friday (5/22) to attach to the packet. Can you confirm scope and whether you have FedRAMP-relevant controls or Fed-specific isolation patterns?

Thanks,
Ellen
E.R. Hayes
State Health Services — IT Procurement

--
Attachment: procurement-sow.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Ellen R. Hayes <ellen.hayes@statehealth.gov>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SSO/SCIM artifacts for SOW — initial request

Ellen — thanks for the clear list. Confirming we can deliver the artifacts below by EOD Friday 5/22 with the following scope. Clarifying questions in-line: 

1) SAML: we will provide SP metadata, ACS endpoints, NameID formats supported, and example IdP metadata. Are you integrating with one IdP or multiple agency IdPs? If multiple, do you need separate metadata per IdP?

2) SCIM: we can provide the provisioning design doc and a sample delta sync report. Our standard delta cadence is event-driven with hourly delta exports; we can generate a calendar-day delta sample as requested. Do you require SCIM v2 schemas extended for custom attributes such as agency-role-id?

3) RBAC: we'll include a role-mapping XLSX plus an exported access_matrix.csv showing current least-privilege assignments for a test tenant. Note that any customer-managed role customizations will be represented as examples.

4) Lifecycle: deprovisioning runbook, session TTLs, and where audit logs are retained (SIEM integration notes). For Fed customers we offer optional private deployment and dedicated VPC separation — is that something you have requested in SOW?

I'll coordinate with Laura (security) and Karthik (identity) to assemble the artifacts. Monica will handle the delivery package and HubSpot record.

Final delivery: Friday 2026-05-22 17:00 PT. If you need anything sooner, please flag the specific item.

Best,
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: none

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SSO/SCIM artifacts for SOW — initial request

Diego — looping in Karthik with an internal checklist and owners. I captured a compact set of artifacts that satisfy typical SOC 2 / SIG / CAIQ requests for access control: 

- SAML/SP metadata (file: saml-metadata.xml) — owner: Karthik
- SCIM design + sample delta (file: scim-delta-report-20260520.pdf) — owner: Karthik
- RBAC mapping (file: role-mapping-v1.xlsx) and access_matrix.csv (export) — owner: Security Engineering (Laura)
- Account lifecycle runbook (doc link included in delivery package) — owner: Product Security
- Evidence pointers for least privilege enforcement (audit query scripts, TTL configs) — owner: Observability team (will supply query snippets)

Notes / constraints:
- Our SP supports NameID: transient, email, persistent. We will supply metadata for both default SP and dedicated VPC variant (if the customer selects Private deployment, they get separate ACS endpoints).
- SCIM: default provisioning is SCIM v2 with support for incremental syncs; we will export a one-day delta CSV sample.
- We will not include production PII in the sample reports; samples will be redacted.

Karthik — can you attach the SAML metadata and a redacted SCIM delta sample by Thursday EOD so Monica can stitch the package? Also include a short note on how we handle orphaned accounts when SCIM provisioning fails (retry windows, manual reconciliation steps).

Laura
Senior Security Manager, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: internal-artifact-checklist.md (text/markdown)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2026 14:23:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SSO/SCIM artifacts for SOW — initial request

Laura / team — attached are the artifacts I'm preparing and a short technical note. Summary: 

- saml-metadata.xml (attached) — includes SP EntityID, ACS endpoints for default and private VPC, and attribute mapping (givenName, familyName, mail, agencyRoleId).
- scim-delta-report-20260520.pdf (attached) — redacted delta showing 312 adds/updates, 7 deletes over 24h; includes timestamps and change vectors.
- role-mapping-v1.xlsx (attached) — maps system roles to minimal scopes; includes example requester and approver roles per SHS requirement.

Technical note highlights (short):
- Provisioning cadence: event-driven with queued reconciliation every 1 hour; we can provide a daily batch export on request.
- Deprovisioning: SCIM DELETE triggers account disable + 72-hour soft-delete window before irreversible purge; sessions revoked at disable event via token revocation API.
- Least privilege: default roles are narrow; cross-tenant admin actions require scoped admin tokens and MFA.

I'll attach the files to the delivery package in SharePoint and provide the redaction checklist.

-Karthik
Identity Engineer, Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: saml-metadata.xml (application/xml), scim-delta-report-20260520.pdf (application/pdf), role-mapping-v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Diego / team — thanks, that looks comprehensive and on schedule. A couple quick follow-ups before we attach: 

1) SCIM delta: SHS security wants to confirm whether the hourly reconciliation could be instrumented to produce signed delta manifests for audit. Is that something you can support or recommend an approach?

2) Role mapping: can you include an explicit mapping of Redwood role -> SHS_permission_scope (for the top 8 roles) so we can drop it into our SIG spreadsheet?

3) Metadata: we will be connecting two agency IdPs initially. Please supply separate IdP examples (or confirm that the metadata you supplied is usable as-is per IdP).

If you can reply with those clarifications early next week it's fine; the SOW attachment will use the package you delivered. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Ellen
